title: Fish Farming: Blue Fish
description: Fish Farming: Blue Fish — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Sir Temdewm

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Collect 7 Blue Fish.

Quest Reward: 2,125 Gold and 1 Kings Coin.

Return to: Sir Temdewm

Repeatable: Yes

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Go and Collect 7 Blue Fish from the Whisker Leaders and Bring them back to Sir Tendewm on Level 2 of Vergrim's Vexation.

Offer:

Blue Fish, whatever that is, is the next item on the list. You have collected these before so it shouldn't be a problem getting more. We've exhausted most of the fish, so now only the leaders are carrying them, so seek them out. Once you have collected all the fish return to me, Sir Tendewm, here on Level 2 of Vergrim's Vexation for your reward.

Turn-in:

Ok, looks like you have all the fish that were needed. Here is a little something for you. Let me know when you are ready to get started again.

Objectives:

  • Blue Fish ×7

Level range: 17–30
